Item.Name: REPORT_NAME
Item.Hint: Enter the report name, use [List] for existing reports.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :ctrl_block_1.REPORT_NAME is null
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Err: Please enter the report name');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
--
 :system.message_level := '10';
 go_block('names');
 execute_query;
 go_block('parm_def');
 execute_query;
 go_block('NAMES');
 :system.message_level := '0';
end;

Item.Name: TITLE
Item.Hint: Enter the Title of the Report.

Item.Name: SUBTITLE
Item.Hint: Enter the Sub Title (if any) for the report.

Trigger.Name: POST-CHANGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :names.report_type not in ('SQL','PC','RPT','SRW' )
 then
 message('Error: Report Type can be SQL/PC/RPT/SRW ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: BATCH_QUEUE
Item.Hint: Enter the Batch Queue which the report should run in when submitted.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :batch_queue is not null and
 is_valid_rpt_master (:ctrl_block_1.appl_id ,
 'QUEUE',:batch_queue) = FALSE then
 message ('Err: Invalid batch queue');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: FORMS_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter the type of form NORMAL, COMPRESSED, LANDSCAPE

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if is_valid_rpt_master (:ctrl_block_1.appl_id ,
 'FORM',:forms_type) = FALSE then
 message ('Err: Invalid form type');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: PRINT_ID
Item.Hint: Enter the Printer ID which would normally be used for this report.

Trigger.Name: KEY-DELREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 select 'x'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from rpt_parm_def
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and report_name = :names.report_name;
 message
 ('All parameters must be deleted before report can be deleted.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 delete_record;
end;

Item.Name: PARM_NO
Item.Hint: Enter the sequence for this parameter. (Valid values: 1 to 99)

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select parm_prompt ,
 code_type
 into :display_prompt,
 :code_type
 from rpt_parm_code
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and parm_code = :parm_code ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 message ('Invalid Parameter code. Use [LIST] for a list');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
--
end;

Item.Name: LIST_ENTRY_FLAG
Item.Hint: Enter "Y" if list of parameters can be entered, else "N".

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :parm_def.list_entry_flag not in ('Y','N')
then
 message
('Err: Enter "Y" if list of parameters can be entered, else "N"');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;
--
--

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select parm_prompt ,
 code_type
 into :display_prompt,
 :code_type
 from rpt_parm_code
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and parm_code = :parm_code ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 :display_prompt := 'Invalid Parameter code';
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
--
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-DELETE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 lock table rpt_parm_select in share update mode;
 delete from rpt_parm_select
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and report_name = :parm_def.report_name
 and parm_no = :parm_def.parm_no;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.block_status in ('NEW','QUERY')
then
 return;
end if;
--
if :parm_def.list_entry_flag = 'Y'
then
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from rpt_parm_code
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and parm_code = :parm_def.parm_code
 and list_entry_flag = 'Y' ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: This parameter cannot accept multiple values.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
end if;

Item.Name: LAF_BEAN
Item.Comment: Java Bean to draw onto the canvas

RecordGroup.Name: PARM_DEF_PARM_CODE_LOV3
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select parm_code, code_type, code_desc , decode(list_entry_flag,'Y','List','') from rpt_parm_code where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id order by parm_code

RecordGroup.Name: NAMES_FORMS_TYPE_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,code_desc from rpt_master_codes where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id and code_type = 'FORM' order by code

RecordGroup.Name: NAMES_BATCH_QUEUE_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,code_desc from rpt_master_codes where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id and code_type = 'QUEUE' order by code

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLOCK__REPORT_NAME_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select report_name, report_type, title from rpt_report_names where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id order by report_name

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :system.cursor_block = 'CTRL_BLOCK_1'
 then
 EXIT_FORM(no_validate);
 else
 go_block('parm_def');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('names');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('ctrl_block_1');
 end if;
end;
